text_block_list.text:
On the way home from an outing with
Narita
Brian...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no one's looking, right?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Groan. Sorry... It's just a bit... Just a teensy little bit!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What the heck is she doing?

We see Rice Shower again in a park a
little later.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my stomach... I-I just need one
more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you were buying taiyaki earlier?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeek! B-B-Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uhhh, please d-d-don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You saw me eat all ten of those taiyaki?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ten?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ten taiyaki... is a bit of an overkill,
isn't
it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oof! Sorry, I'm sorry! I was just really,
really
hungry!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And Hishiama just warned me not
to eat
too much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice, you idiot! Why can't you control
yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah! Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Stop apologizing. Though... hiding out
and
stuffing your face is probably
something you
should reconsider.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah, you're right... I'm really a

good-for-nothing. I'm sorry, and I'm
sorry to
Hishiama too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No, you got it wrong. Amazon wasn't trying to tell you not to eat.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She was just... worried. About you.
About your
health.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: M-my... health?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Eating junk food in secret and not
getting proper
nutrition is the opposite
of what she wanted for
you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you feel like you're not getting
enough to eat,
just tell Amazon.
Knowing her, I'm sure she'll
listen to you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh... u-uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Waaah! I'm... I'm... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: H-hey, why are you crying?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah, damn it... Trainer, you figure this
out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a trainer's job to cheer us up,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a trainer's job to cheer us up,
isn't it?
choice_data_list: Let's just run off whatever we ate!
We'll go apologize together with you.
We'll go with you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Run?
choice_data_list: Let's just run off whatever we ate!
We'll go apologize together with you.
We'll go with you to apologize.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good idea. That's what I'd do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I run... I can work off what I ate...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm going to run! And after
that... I'll
apologize to Hishiama!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean right now? If you run
right after
eating all that—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: She's not even listening.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. So this must be how Amazon
always feels.

Narita Brian mutters at Rice Shower's
back as she
runs off at full speed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
We'll do what?! Why the heck should I
have to sit
through a lecture too?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ohhh... A l-lecture...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, don't you start getting freaked
out now.
Like I said, she's just worried
about you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Brian...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
How do you know so much about
Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: None of your business.

In the end, Narita Brian ends up going
along with
Rice Shower to see Hishi
Amazon.
